mentions.name: Machine vision movement detection app
mentions.description: This app uses machine vision to detect human movement and can connect via video call to other instances of the app. It is implemented mostly in Flutter/Dart, includes some Android-exclusive functionality, and is being extended with Android AppFunctions to support on-device agents in Android 17.
